title: Fox's vision of Tim Coleman keying his car
summary: James Fox tells of Fox's vision of Tim Coleman keying his car, about late 1990s / early 2000s at editing building for Out of the Blue, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: editing building for Out of the Blue

tellings.quote: editing I get a visual image in my head I see him with a key clear as day

plain: James Fox, a documentary filmmaker who investigates UFOs, says that while editing his film Out of the Blue, around the late 1990s or early 2000s, he suddenly got a picture in his head, clear as day, of a man named Tim Coleman holding a key. He tells it as a vision that Coleman was scratching his car with that key, a kind of knowing he could not explain.
